explanation: A designation for God, referring to his sovereignty and authority.
The area that God promised to give the people of Israel as their homeland.
To give an assurance or pledge about something; in this case, God's promise of the land to the Israelites.
A reference to the time when the Israelites were slaves in Egypt before the exodus.
A dry, inhospitable landscape where the Israelites wandered for 40 years after leaving Egypt.
A trial or challenge that God gave the Israelites to see if they would follow his commands and learn to trust him.
A miraculous food product that God provided to the Israelites while they were in the wilderness.
To bring someone to a lower position, often to teach them to depend on God.
To correct or guide someone to help them learn and grow.
The state of forgetting or not remembering something; in this case, God's deeds and commands.
